rules.statement: An agent who acts without formal authority from the principal is not personally liable for damages if there was no fraudulent intent or recklessness, and the agent did not enter into a valid contract with the third party.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held , per Withers, J., and Browne, A.J. (dissentiente Lawrie, A.C.J .), that, in the absence of fraudulent intent or recklessness, A was not personally liable in damages ; and that he had not entered into a valid contract with C, nor was he under a legal duty to him to state the truth."
